claims.value: Two biological anti-TSSK2 mouse-testis IP replicates plus one mouse-IgG control.
claims.evidence: The paper explicitly describes both replicate TSSK2 complexes, run names identify the two acquisitions and IgG control, and all 3 RAW basenames are covered exactly once.

claims.value: Q Exactive HF DDA-HCD; Trypsin; 10 ppm/0.02 Da; fixed Carbamidomethyl and variable Oxidation/Protein N-terminal Acetyl.
claims.evidence: Instrument/acquisition are explicit in PRIDE and the paper; enzyme, tolerances, and modifications were read from the deposited PD/Mascot MSF.

limitations: The paper establishes adult (>8-week-old) male mice and identifies the two TSSK2 acquisitions as biological replicates, but does not provide animal-level identifiers.
The IgG control has no second deposited acquisition, so it is represented as the single available control.
The reconciler cannot inspect the downloaded MSF and therefore emits a false cleavage-agent warning; deposited search settings explicitly specify Trypsin.
